close_reason: Added require_tls: bool to SessionState::Mail and Rcpt; capture from MAIL FROM args; propagate through RCPT to DATA handler; use in Received: header per RFC 3848/8689
description: session.rs: has_requiretls_param(args) is called in MAIL FROM handler and rejects the command on non-TLS sessions, but the result is not stored in SessionState::Mail. The struct has {ehlo_domain, from} only. At DATA time, the sieve_delivery call has no way to know REQUIRETLS was requested. No relay_queue.enqueue() call passes require_tls. The inbound REQUIRETLS validation gives a false sense of security — the end-to-end TLS requirement is never propagated to outbound delivery.
title: REQUIRETLS flag parsed at MAIL FROM but never stored in SessionState
